body:
[~accountid:712020:aa00b8d6-a71f-4259-8919-82a304227c20] Hi Chris, during QA on production we found that the text typed in the Work Orders *Search* box is sent to Google Analytics: it is inside the page address that goes with every Work Orders usage record (the view shown, each field loaded, the density loaded). The PRD (S12-R5) says analytics may hold field names and setting values, but no search text, names, identifiers or dollar amounts. Details and a picture are in the description above.

Could you please confirm whether this should be *fast-followed* (fixed in the Fast Follow) or *obsoleted*? Thank you.
